title: fix(er-diagram): handle syntax errors for special characters in node names
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR fixes a bug in ER diagrams where node names containing `'u'`, numbers, or decimal values caused syntax errors.  
With this change, such identifiers are now parsed correctly and supported.


## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

- Adjusted ER diagram grammar to allow special characters (`'u'`, digits, decimals) in node names.  
- Kept compatibility with existing syntax and naming rules.  
- Added validation to ensure only valid identifiers are accepted.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body:
The positive lookahead pattern `(?=\s+[A-Za-z_"'])` may not match all valid relationship contexts. Consider using a more comprehensive pattern that includes other valid cardinality indicators and relationship symbols like `||`, `}`, `{`, `|`, `o`, etc.
```suggestion
"1"(?=\s+([A-Za-z_"'\|\{\}\|o]))           return 'ONLY_ONE';
```

comments.author: omkarht
comments.body: Thanks for the suggestion! However, this approach has syntax errors and inverted logic that break existing tests. The current implementation correctly distinguishes cardinality vs. entity names with zero state conflicts.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment identifies a potential issue with the lookahead pattern and provides a specific code suggestion to fix it by including additional valid cardinality indicators and relationship symbols.
